cards.ex: We hit it off immediately and talked for hours.
cards.exUz: Biz darhol kelishib ketdik va soatlab gaplashdik.
cards.uzDef: Birinchi uchrashuvdayoq yaxshi munosabat o'rnatmoq, tezda do'stlashmoq.

cards.ex: I get along with my neighbors really well.
cards.exUz: Men qo'shnilarim bilan juda yaxshi kelishaman.
cards.uzDef: Biri bilan yaxshi munosabatda bo'lmoq, urushmasdan birga bo'lmoq.

cards.ex: They fell out with each other over a silly argument.
cards.exUz: Ular bema'ni bahs tufayli bir-birlari bilan urishib qolishdi.
cards.uzDef: Biri bilan janjallashib, munosabatlarni buzmoq.

cards.ex: They had a big fight, but they made up the next day.
cards.exUz: Ular katta janjallashishdi, lekin ertasi kuni yarashib olishdi.
cards.uzDef: Uzoq janjaldan keyin yana do'stlashmoq, kelishmoq.

cards.ex: We used to be close, but we've drifted apart over the years.
cards.exUz: Biz ilgari yaqin edik, lekin yillar davomida uzoqlashib ketdik.
cards.uzDef: Vaqt o'tishi bilan do'stlik munosabatlari susayib, uzoqlashmoq.

cards.ex: She's always been a shoulder to cry on when I'm feeling down.
cards.exUz: U har doim men tushkunlikka tushganimda yordam beradigan do'st bo'lgan.
cards.uzDef: Qiyin paytlarda yordam beradigan, eshitadigan do'st.

cards.ex: We're always on the same wavelength, so it's easy to work together.
cards.exUz: Biz har doim bir xil fikrdamiz, shuning uchun birga ishlash oson.
cards.uzDef: Fikrlari, qarashlari o'xshash odamlar.

cards.ex: They come from a very close-knit family and support each other a lot.
cards.exUz: Ular juda ahil oiladan chiqqan va bir-birlarini juda qo'llab-quvvatlashadi.
cards.uzDef: Bir-biri bilan juda yaqin va doimiy yordam beradigan oila.

cards.ex: I'm going on a blind date tonight, wish me luck!
cards.exUz: Men bugun ko'rmagan odam bilan uchrashuvga boryapman, omad tilang!
cards.uzDef: Avval tanish bo'lmagan odam bilan tashkil qilingan uchrashuv.

cards.ex: We're going on a double date with Sarah and Tom this weekend.
cards.exUz: Biz bu hafta oxiri Saroh va Tom bilan juftlik uchrashuviga boryapmiz.
cards.uzDef: Ikki juftlikning birga o'tkazadigan uchrashuvi.

cards.ex: I think I have a crush on my classmate.
cards.exUz: Menimcha, men sinfdoshimga ko'ngil qo'yganman.
cards.uzDef: Kimnidir yoqtirib qolmoq, sevgi hissini tuyg'u.

cards.ex: He's planning to pop the question on their anniversary.
cards.exUz: U ularning yilligi kunida qo'l so'rashni rejalashtirmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Turmush qurishni taklif qilmoq, taklif qilmoq.

cards.ex: They're planning to tie the knot next summer.
cards.exUz: Ular kelasi yozda nikohdan o'tishni rejalashtirishyapti.
cards.uzDef: Turmush qurmoq, nikoh rishtalarini bog'lamoq.

cards.ex: So, when are you two getting hitched?
cards.exUz: Xo'sh, qachon turmush qurasizlar?
cards.uzDef: Nikohdan o'tmoq, oila qurmoq (norasmiy).

cards.ex: I'm ready to settle down and start a family.
cards.exUz: Men o'rnashib, oila qurishga tayyorman.
cards.uzDef: Oilali bo'lib, tinch hayot kechirmoq.

cards.ex: I'm afraid he's stuck in the friend zone.
cards.exUz: Qo'rqamanki, u do'stlik zonasida qolib ketgan.
cards.uzDef: Romantik munosabatlar o'rniga do'st bo'lib qolish holati.

cards.ex: Let's meet up for coffee sometime next week.
cards.exUz: Kelasi hafta qachondir qahva ichish uchun uchrashaylik.
cards.uzDef: Rejalashtirilgan joyda, vaqtda ko'rishmoq.

cards.ex: We just like to hang out and watch movies.
cards.exUz: Biz shunchaki vaqt o'tkazishni va filmlarni tomosha qilishni xohlaymiz.
cards.uzDef: Do'stlar bilan erkin, mazza qilib vaqt o'tkazmoq.

cards.ex: It's been ages! We need to catch up soon.
cards.exUz: Ko'p vaqt o'tdi! Tez orada gaplashib olishimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Uzoq vaqt ko'rishmagan do'stlar bilan yangiliklarni bilish.

cards.ex: Let's keep in touch after you move.
cards.exUz: Ko'chib o'tganingizdan keyin aloqada bo'laylik.
cards.uzDef: Telefon, xabar yoki ijtimoiy tarmoqlar orqali aloqani saqlamoq.

cards.ex: She's such a social butterfly, she knows everyone.
cards.exUz: U juda ijtimoiylashuvchi, u hamma bilan tanish.
cards.uzDef: Ko'p do'stlari bor va yangi odamlar bilan tanishishni yaxshi ko'radigan odam.

cards.ex: He's a real party animal; he loves going out every night.
cards.exUz: U haqiqiy bazmchi; u har kecha tashqariga chiqishni yaxshi ko'radi.
cards.uzDef: Doim partilarda yuradigan, ko'p ichadigan odam.

cards.ex: She's playing hard to get, but I think she likes me.
cards.exUz: U o'zini olib qochyapti, lekin menimcha u meni yoqtiradi.
cards.uzDef: Kimdirning e'tiborini qozonish uchun qiyin bo'lishga harakat qilmoq.

cards.ex: I felt like a third wheel when I went out with them.
cards.exUz: Men ular bilan birga chiqqanimda o'zimni ortiqcha odamdek his qildim.
cards.uzDef: Ikki oshiqning yonida keraksiz bo'lib qolgan odam.

cards.ex: He's a fair-weather friend; he disappears when things get tough.
cards.exUz: U qiyinchiliksiz do'st; ishlar qiyinlashganda u g'oyib bo'ladi.
cards.uzDef: Faqat yaxshi kunlarda do'st bo'ladigan, qiyin paytda tashlab ketadigan do'st.

cards.ex: It takes time to get over someone after a breakup.
cards.exUz: Ajralishdan keyin kimnidir unutish uchun vaqt kerak.
cards.uzDef: Sevgidan so'ng xafa bo'lishni to'xtatmoq, qayg'uni yengmoq.

cards.ex: You need to move on and forget about him.
cards.exUz: Siz oldinga yurishingiz va uni unutishingiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: O'tmishdagi muammolarni unutib, yangi hayotga o'tmoq.

cards.ex: We had a heart-to-heart about our relationship.
cards.exUz: Biz munosabatlarimiz haqida dildan gaplashdik.
cards.uzDef: O'z hissiyotlari haqida samimiy, chuqur gaplashmoq.

cards.ex: The company is trying to build bridges with the local community.
cards.exUz: Kompaniya mahalliy hamjamiyat bilan ko'priklar qurishga harakat qilmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Ajdodlar o'rtasidagi munosabatlarni yaxshilamoq.

cards.ex: She is a social climber who is always trying to impress important people.
cards.exUz: U har doim muhim odamlarga ta'sir o'tkazishga harakat qiladigan mansabparastdir.
cards.uzDef: Yuqori jamiyatga kirishni xohlaydigan odam.
